topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
subtopic: Variable Annuity Surrender Charges and Annual Fees
source_evidence: Early withdrawal from a variable annuity investment will usually result in a surrender charge.
answer: Variable annuities can involve both a one-time charge and recurring costs. A surrender charge may apply if you withdraw early; it is a transaction fee. You may also pay annual fees for administering the annuity, insurance, or optional features called riders. The annuity’s underlying investments can have annual operating expenses too. These ongoing fees reduce the amount of money in your portfolio that is earning a return. Review the annuity’s disclosures and ask which fees apply, how much they are, and whether an early withdrawal could trigger a surrender charge.
